scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and all twelve translations, duplicate publication metadata, product specifications against Lenovo PSREF, personal keyboard behavior, Windows 10 lifecycle, Windows 11 processor support, and reference links.
findings: Removed duplicate publication dates, retained the 2023 purchase date, and set lastmod to the review date.
Clarified that the Pause-to-Settings shortcut was a personal key mapping, and that Shift+F10 opens the context menu when no App key is present.
Added a current support note: Windows 10 regular support ended in 2025, ESU terms are stated with current scope, and this Core i7-7600U is absent from Microsoft’s supported Windows 11 processor list.
Updated the Lenovo reference to the current PSREF and added official Microsoft sources.
Clarified that personal condition and battery observations describe the January 2023 review period.
